task toolhead-r11c-extruder-heads — the RM.Extruder tool-head rows, representative-row form (the B1/r11e walk-declaration convention). Eight upstream walk families, one representative row each per family statement: (1) the metal Shape_Extruder forging rows (Loader_Recipes_Handlers.java:750-762 head subset: raw shovel/sword/hoe/saw/pickaxe/axe + finished file/hammer), walk = OreDictPrefix.VALUES x containsAny(EXTRUDER_FODDER, INGOT_BASED, GEM_BASED) x the material's EXTRUDER gate — representative input gt6:ingot_iron; EUt 96 (the aHot forging column), duration = RecipeMapHandlerPrefixForging.getCosts (max(16, 1+|(meltingPoint-293)*weight|/(75*96)); the Iron representative computes 185/369/554/1107 t; upstream the duration is per-material runtime, the JSON carries the Iron representative value). (2) the metal Shape_SimpleEx mirror (:783-795 head subset), same walk + DUST_BASED, EUt 16, duration = UT.Code.units(outputU, U, 64, T) = 64 t per output unit (64/96/128/192/384). (3)+(4) the stone stonetypes rows (RM.java:410-414/:417 Shape + :423-427/:430 SimpleEx), walk = the GT6 stone-family materials x the four block forms (aStone/aCobble/aSmooth/aDustBlock) — representative input minecraft:stone. (5)+(6) the BlockStones metatype rows (BlockStones.java:293-297/:300 + :308-312/:315), walk = every BlockStones metatype block — representative input gt6:granite. (7)+(8) the Blackstone special rows (Loader_Recipes_Extruder.java:51-58 + :66-73; the SPEC's :51-53 shovel/sword/hoe lines plus their :54-55/:58 pickaxe/axe/hammer continuations), representative input minecraft:blackstone — DECLARED DEVIATION: the upstream input is Module_Blackstone_Generator, a port-absent item; the port substitutes the Blackstone stone item (GT6Anvils: OP.stone.dat(Blackstone) = vanilla BLACKSTONE), counts and durations verbatim. DECLARED DEVIATION (both metal families): upstream each aHot statement emits a config-conditional row pair (96 EUt under EXTRUDER_SIMPLE.NOT + 16 EUt under EXTRUDER_SIMPLE); the config-less JSON keeps one row per statement at its family's column, so both mold families answer on every config. DECLARED POOL: the Shape_Extruder/SimpleEx non-head rows (plate/plateCurved/rod/rodLong/bolt/gear/gearSmall/ingot/block/casing/wire/foil/pipe families) and the mold-crafting chain (needs the port-absent Shape_Extruder_Empty) stay pooled; the plate/rod rows already pour via GT6RecipesExtruder (FMLCommonSetup). Molds enter the second input slot and are never consumed (Recipe.sNotConsumable <- gt6:extruder_shapes tag membership; the upstream size-0 marker port, remember id478).

task recipe-b5-extruder-statics appends 175 rows: (A) the Loader_Recipes_Extruder literal module-domain
stations, 138 rows — the five 30-row domains (:44-73 Blackstone, :75-104 Basalt, :106-135 Stone,
:137-166 stone W-meta, :168-197 cobblestone) minus the 12 head rows r11c already shipped; the
Module_*_Generator inputs are port-absent and ride the declared r11c substitution (minecraft:blackstone /
gt6:basalt / minecraft:stone / minecraft:cobblestone). (B) the LRE prefix-walk (the :202 qualifying filter
over 37 port prefixes) as 9 representative rows — the walk call sites whose output items the port
registers (glass plate/cell/bottle, TinAlloy cell, Zr cell).
DISCARDED-ROWS LEDGER (file-head disclosure, the acceptance pin):
  LRE walk call sites NOT poured (16, output item port-absent): :210/:211 + :218/:219 wax pills
    (Pill_Empty unported), :221/:222 WaxBee + :231/:232 WaxRefractory + :241/:242 WaxMagic/WaxAmnesic
    cell rows (FR_* Forestry capsules unported), :265/:266 Plastic (PlasticCan unported),
    :274/:275 Sn cells (Cell_Empty item unported), :276/:277 Sn bottles (IC2_Food_Can_Empty unported).
  BACKFILLED-BY recipe-b5-backfill-wire-unlocks — the 7 x 2 formerly deferred Handlers statements
    are live rows now: :748/:781-wire wireGt01 (output = the WIRES-face AnnealedCopper representative
    gt6:wire_annealed_copper_gt01 — the WIRES gate has no Iron member; DECLARED IDENTITY MAPPING
    over the GTWires block items, the upstream OreDictManager.setTarget_ oredient isomorph (task
    wiregt-prefix-item-retirement retired the wire-gt-registration item-path lift)), :751-755/:784-788 pipeTiny/Small/Medium/Large/Huge
    (output = the GTFluidPipes block items gt6:copper_fluid_pipe_*, slug copper; DECLARED IDENTITY
    MAPPING — the upstream OP.pipe* targets ride the MultiTileEntityPipeFluid block path,
    Loader_MultiTileEntities setTarget_), :766/:799 capcellcon (output = the GT6Cells block item
    gt6:cell_tin, the U9 capsule ratio; DECLARED IDENTITY MAPPING over the Loader_MultiTileEntities
    :1770-1809 cell family). Durations: the getCosts replica calibrated on the shipped Iron columns
    (185/369/554/738/1107/1661 verbatim) evaluated on the representatives — Copper 148/442/883/1766,
    Tin 24, AnnealedCopper 347; the SimpleEx units column 64/192/384/768.
  (C) the Handlers non-head forging walk as 28 representative rows — 14 statements x 2 families
    (:741-747/:749/:763-769 Shape 96-EUt melting-point columns,
    :774-780/:782/:796-798/:800-802 SimpleEx 16-EUt units
    columns), Iron representative, the r11c head-row convention.
THE 64-MOLD LEDGER (the mold-extruder-shapes family, per family 31 usable + 1 Empty lead):
  poured rows exist for 31 types per family (14 stone-domain r11c + saw/file r11c metal +
  ingot/ring/casing/plateTiny/foil/wireFine + bottle/cell + wire/pipes x5/ccc by the backfill card)
  = 62 molds; zero deferred (the backfill resolved the last 7 types over the declared identity
  mappings); the 2 Shape_*_Empty leads carry no consumption rows upstream (crafting-chain only,
  the mold card's forge rows) = TRUE NEGATIVE. 62 + 0 + 2 = 64.
DECLARED DEVIATION (the W-meta domains :137-166/:168-197): the upstream inputs are meta-wildcard
  stone/cobblestone and overlap the r11c stonetypes rows on input pairs (both sets coexist upstream;
  the JSON rows carry the count-1 canonical representative, the findRecipe first-hit order is the
  documented three-owner limitation).
